title: bromus insignis var. scopulorum
intro: Bromus insignis var. scopulorum, commonly known as Mountain Brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its roots and rhizomes are used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Mountain Brome include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
